criteria.name: required_server_backed_workspace
criteria.description:
From a signed-out page, sign in as `avery@dropline.test` with `password123`.
Require successful same-origin application requests and a protected workspace
that visibly identifies Avery and contains a game board, status, totals,
history, and game controls. A static imitation with no successful application
request does not pass. Do not start, reset, or play a game.
criteria.reasoning: Avery’s protected workspace visibly rendered with identity, board, status, totals, history, and controls. Same-origin POST /api/login and GET /api/game both returned 200.

criteria.name: self_contained_refresh_runtime
criteria.description:
While Avery's workspace is visible, fully reload the page and require the
authenticated workspace to render again and remain usable. Browser network
evidence must show that the application works from the same origin without a
required public-origin script, stylesheet, font, image, API, or runtime
package install. Do not require any particular saved board, history, or totals.
criteria.reasoning: After a full reload, Avery’s workspace rendered again and controls remained available. Reload network evidence showed only same-origin 200 responses for / and /api/game, with no public-origin dependencies.

criteria.name: authenticated_account_workflow
criteria.description:
Confirm the signed-in workspace identifies Avery Morgan and
`avery@dropline.test`. Start New game, drop once in column 3, sign out, and
confirm protected board and totals disappear. Attempt Avery's email with
`wrong-pass-47` and require visible rejection without protected state. Then
sign back in with `password123` and require the Red piece at row 6 column 3,
`Yellow's turn`, and exactly one history entry naming Red, column 3, row 6.
criteria.reasoning: Avery identity verified; sign-out hid protected state; wrong password was rejected; re-login restored the exact Red move at row 6, column 3 and Yellow's turn.

criteria.name: gravity_turns_and_full_column
criteria.description:
Play columns 4,4,4. Require Red at row 6 column 4, Yellow at row 5 column 4,
Red at row 4 column 4, every other cell empty, `Yellow's turn`, and three
matching history entries. Start New game and click column 1 six times. Require
bottom-to-top Red, Yellow, Red, Yellow, Red, Yellow and `Red's turn`. Record all
cells, history, and totals; one more click must show `Column 1 is full` without
changing board, turn, history, Undo/Redo availability, or totals.
criteria.reasoning: Both exact sequences passed, including gravity, turns, history, and unchanged state after the full-column attempt.

criteria.name: horizontal_and_vertical_wins
criteria.description:
Record Red's total, then play 1,7,2,7,3,6,4. Require `Red wins`, exactly row 6
columns 1-4 marked winning, seven history entries, and Red's total increased by
one. Start New game, play 1,2,1,2,1,2,1, and require `Red wins`, exactly column
1 rows 3-6 marked winning, seven history entries, and Red's total increased by
one again. No other cell is winning.
criteria.reasoning: Both exact sequences produced the specified Red wins, markers, seven history entries, and sequential score increases.

criteria.name: both_diagonal_wins
criteria.description:
Play 1,2,2,3,4,3,3,4,5,4,4. Require `Red wins` with exactly row 6 column 1,
row 5 column 2, row 4 column 3, and row 3 column 4 marked winning. Start New
game and play 7,6,6,5,4,5,5,4,3,4,4. Require the mirrored win at row 3 column
4, row 4 column 5, row 5 column 6, and row 6 column 7. Require eleven matching
history entries and no other winning cell in either game.
criteria.reasoning: Both exact 11-move sequences produced the specified four-cell diagonal markers with no extras and matching histories.

criteria.name: yellow_win_and_terminal_lock
criteria.description:
Record Yellow's total, then play 7,1,7,2,6,3,6,4. Require `Yellow wins`, exactly
the four Yellow pieces at row 6 columns 1-4 marked winning, eight history
entries, and Yellow's total increased by one. Record board, result, markers,
history, and totals; attempt columns 5 and 1. Require every recorded value to
remain exactly unchanged.
criteria.reasoning: The exact sequence produced the specified Yellow win and score increase; later drops left all recorded state unchanged.

criteria.name: exact_draw_and_terminal_lock
criteria.description:
Record Draws, then play exactly
4,4,4,4,4,4,3,3,3,3,3,3,5,2,5,6,5,5,5,5,2,2,2,2,2,6,1,6,6,6,6,1,1,1,1,1,7,7,7,7,7,7.
Require all 42 cells occupied, visible result exactly `Draw`, zero winning
markers, exactly 42 history entries, and Draws increased by one. Attempt one
later drop and require board, result, history, and totals unchanged.
criteria.reasoning: All 42 exact moves filled the board as Draw with no winning markers; the later drop changed nothing.

criteria.name: move_history_undo_redo_branching
criteria.description:
Start New game and play 4,5,4. Require the history to read, in order, Red at
column 4 row 6, Yellow at column 5 row 6, and Red at column 4 row 5. Undo twice.
Require only the first Red piece and first history entry to remain, status
`Yellow's turn`, and Redo available. Reload and require that exact state. Redo
once and require the Yellow piece/history entry restored with `Red's turn` and
another Redo still available. Now play column 2. Require a new Red entry at
column 2 row 6 and Redo unavailable; a Redo attempt, if the UI permits one,
must change nothing.

Then start New game, record Red's total, and play 1,7,2,7,3,6,4. Require the
Red win and one score increment. Undo once: require an active round with
`Red's turn`, the last Red piece and every winning marker removed, six history
entries, and the Red total returned to its baseline. Reload and require the
same undo state. Redo once: require the identical Red win, four markers, seven
history entries, and exactly one restored score increment. Redo is then
unavailable and cannot increment the score again.
criteria.reasoning: Undo, reload persistence, redo, branching, terminal-win undo, reload, redo, score restoration, and redo locking all passed.

criteria.name: new_game_reset_and_persistence
criteria.description:
Create the Red win with 1,7,2,7,3,6,4, record all three match totals, then
activate New game. Require all 42 cells empty, no winning markers, no history,
Undo and Redo unavailable, status exactly `Red's turn`, and recorded totals
unchanged. Click column 7 and require Red at row 6 column 7, one matching
history entry, and `Yellow's turn`. Fully reload the page and require that exact
one-piece board, history, turn, totals, and Undo availability to remain.
criteria.reasoning: New game cleared the round while preserving totals; the exact column-7 move and all state persisted after reload.

criteria.name: accessible_grid_and_winning_names
criteria.description:
Confirm the board exposes one grid with exactly 42 grid cells and every initial
cell name identifies its row, column, and empty state. Play 1,7,2,7,3,6,4.
Require exactly four winning Red cells; each accessible name must include its
row, column, Red, and `winning`, while no other cell name includes `winning`.
criteria.reasoning: One grid with 42 cells; initial labels identified each row, column, and empty state. The required sequence produced exactly four winning Red cells, rows 6 columns 1–4.

criteria.name: keyboard_navigation_and_drop
criteria.description:
Focus `Drop in column 1`. Without pointer navigation, press ArrowRight and
require column 2 focus, End for column 7, Home for column 1, ArrowLeft and
require focus remains at column 1, then Right twice and Left once for column 2.
Press Enter and require Red at row 6 column 2; press Space on the same focused
control and require Yellow at row 5 column 2 with focus still usable. Require
two matching move-history entries. Navigate to Undo without a pointer and
activate it; require the Yellow move removed and Redo enabled. Navigate to Redo
and activate it; require the same Yellow move restored with focus still usable.
criteria.reasoning: Arrow/Home/End navigation, Enter/Space drops, history, keyboard Undo, and Redo all worked with usable focus.

criteria.name: responsive_layout_and_feedback
criteria.description:
At exactly 375 by 760 pixels, confirm the sign-in form fits without horizontal
page overflow. Sign in and require identity, complete board, seven controls,
status, totals, move history, Undo, Redo, New game, and Sign out to remain
reachable and usable without clipping or overlapping text. Fill column 1 and
click it again; require noticeable `Column 1 is full` feedback without
introducing overflow.
criteria.reasoning: At 375×760, document width remained exactly 375px with no horizontal overflow. Required content stayed reachable in a vertical flow, and a full column showed visible “Column 1 is full” feedback.

criteria.name: visual_hierarchy_and_craft
criteria.description:
At desktop size and 375 by 760, require an intentional hierarchy, consistent
spacing, legible typography, purposeful color, polished sign-in and identity
treatment, distinct Red and Yellow pieces, readable scores and history, strong
focus states, and an obvious winning treatment. Fail for clipping, overlap,
low-contrast controls, or visually ambiguous game state.
criteria.reasoning: Desktop and mobile views had clear hierarchy, legible typography, distinct pieces, readable scores/history, strong focus styling, and an obvious winning treatment without overlap.

criteria.name: game_identity_and_production_readiness
criteria.description:
Confirm sign-in, saved account state, board, status, scores, move history,
Undo/Redo, New game, feedback, and sign-out form one coherent finished
board-game product rather than disconnected demo surfaces. Exercise moves,
Undo, Redo, and a win; require understandable feedback and controls that remain
usable throughout.
criteria.reasoning: Avery sign-in, saved state, game controls, status feedback, scores, history, Undo/Redo, New game, win flow, and sign-out formed a coherent product.

criteria.name: page_load_and_refresh
criteria.description:
Open the same-origin page and require a substantive DropLine sign-in screen
with a visible heading, email and password fields, and a usable sign-in
control. Fully refresh once and require the same usable page to render again
without a blank screen, fatal error, or broken layout that blocks the form.
criteria.reasoning: Rendered DropLine sign-in screen showed a heading, email and password fields, and a usable Sign in button. After a full refresh, the same form rendered again without a blank or blocking layout.

criteria.name: basic_control_and_game_surface
criteria.description:
Click the visible `Use Avery` helper and require it to populate the email field.
Enter `password123`, sign in, and require a substantive game workspace to
render with Avery's identity, a visible Connect Four board, game status, match
totals, move history, and visible game controls. Do not require a particular
saved board, history, score, or enabled state.
criteria.reasoning: Clicking Use Avery populated avery@dropline.test. After entering password123 and signing in, the rendered workspace showed Avery Morgan, a Connect Four board, game status, match totals, move history, and visible game controls.
